verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';if(!fs.readdirSync('lib/sites/editor').some(f=>/authorizeWebsiteEditor/.test(r('lib/sites/editor/'+f))&&/saveWebsiteMenu/.test(r('lib/sites/editor/'+f)))){console.error('SCAN-832: the menu editor mounted on the website host has no host-authorized actions');process.exit(1)}"

append.detail: FIXED 2026-10-20. lib/sites/editor/menu-actions.ts holds the host-authorized twins (loadWebsiteMenu, saveWebsiteMenu, resetWebsiteMenu, saveWebsiteHeaderLogo, uploadWebsiteLogo), each gated by authorizeWebsiteEditor(host). The reads and writes are shared with the Space console through lib/spaces/site-menu-core.ts, and SiteMenuEditor takes its server calls from SiteMenuActionsProvider, which ConnectedWebsiteEditor fills with the host twins. Covered by lib/sites/editor/menu-actions.test.ts; the authenticated click-through on a site host is Daniel's look.
